findings.title: Prompt template listing endpoint is unguarded
findings.suggested_fix: Add authz guard and actor-scoped filtering/redaction for template content.

findings.title: RAG quality report/replay endpoints allow unauthenticated read/write
findings.suggested_fix: Protect `/api/v1/rag/quality/*` endpoints with explicit authz and validate `runId` input.

findings.title: Semantic promotion loop can overwrite active semantic snapshot term-by-term
findings.suggested_fix: Publish one semantic registry version per domain/scope per event from the full resolved winner set.

findings.title: R6 gate uses synthetic hardcoded values for critical metrics
findings.suggested_fix: Source stale-cache/graph-fallback/security metrics from telemetry; mark as insufficient samples when unavailable.

findings.title: Frontend evidence normalizer drops `promptTemplate` contract field
findings.suggested_fix: Preserve/normalize `promptTemplate` in `normalizeEvidence` and assert it in unit tests.

findings.title: Build job can report failure after successful activation when replay write fails
findings.suggested_fix: Separate activation success from best-effort replay persistence and avoid rethrowing telemetry-only failures.

findings.title: Required-domain coverage is skipped when candidate limit is already full
findings.suggested_fix: Replace lower-ranked non-required candidates to enforce required-domain inclusion under saturation.

findings.title: Event idempotency handling lacks in-flight deduplication and can double-process
findings.suggested_fix: Add per-idempotency in-flight lock and durable idempotency state boundary.

findings.title: RAG schema allows cross-datasource FK mismatch for denormalized datasource IDs
findings.suggested_fix: Use composite FK/unique constraints tying child datasource IDs to parent records, or remove redundant datasource columns.

findings.title: Queue wait metric uses 24h sample count against a 6h threshold spec
findings.suggested_fix: Track and report a dedicated 6h sample count for `orchestratorQueueWaitP95Ms`.

pre_existing.title: Admin role can be spoofed through request headers
pre_existing.suggested_fix: Trust only verified auth claims and remove raw header role fallback in AdminOnlyGuard.

residual_actionable: All non-pre-existing findings route to downstream-resolver (manual/gated).
